R. W. Eash, K. S. Chon, Y. J. Lee, D. E. Boyce (1983). Equilibrium traffic assignment on an aggregated highway network for sketch planning. Transportation Research Record 994, 30-37.

description: An aggregated sketch planning network of the Chicago region developed by the Chicago Area Transportation Study (times in minutes, lengths in miles, tolls in cents); the repository's readme recommends doubling the trip table for algorithm testing, which this entry does not do. From Transportation Networks for Research, the traffic assignment test networks that continue H. Bar-Gera's TNTP collection, read from the repository at commit d1639b4ef218 in the TNTP format: the network file's links are directed edges of type link carrying capacity, length, freeFlowTime, b, power, speed, toll, linkType, and nodes 1 to 387 are zones (type zone) and the rest of type node; each origin-destination entry of the trip table is a node of type commodity carrying its demand, joined by an origin edge and a destination edge to its two zones, zero entries included as the file lists them. The node coordinate files are not read. The best known equilibrium link flows are in the repository's ChicagoSketch_flow.tntp, which this entry lists as a source and does not merge.
